name: Web MIDI (midi and midi sysex)
plain: Asks to talk to connected music gear such as keyboards and controllers.
meaning: Two permission levels: plain MIDI sees note and control data; sysex also sends vendor system messages that can reprogram a device. Reveals which music devices you own.

access.prompt_ui: Chromium prompt: Control and reprogram your MIDI devices when sysex is requested; Chrome 124 prompts for any MIDI access. Firefox 108 needs an add-on install for sysex.

limits.headline: Can talk to your connected music gear, with a prompt for deeper control
limits.user_action: You tap Connect keyboard or Connect MIDI on a music site.
can: Listen to notes from a keyboard or controller you have plugged in
Send notes and lights to the device
Ask for deeper control, called sysex, that shows a stronger warning
cannot: Use any music gear before you allow it
Change the gear's settings with sysex unless you allow that
Work in Safari or on iPhone
Keep access after you clear permissions or close the site
limits.differs: Chrome, Edge and Firefox support it. Firefox may need an add on for sysex. Safari and iPhone do not.

story.what_it_is: A site asks to connect to your music gear, like a keyboard or drum pad.

marketing.name: Web MIDI API
marketing.pitch: MDN says the API lets pages talk to MIDI devices like keyboards and drum machines.

story.for_you: A pop up asks 'Allow this site to use your MIDI devices?'. If you say yes, a plugged in keyboard plays notes in the page.
story.for_makers: Makers can build full music apps in a tab: synths, lessons and recording. A special system mode can even rewrite a device's settings, so the browser asks more carefully.

use_cases.example: You play a plugged in keyboard and hear piano notes in the browser.
A piano lesson site watches which keys you press and scores you.
A rhythm game lets you play with a MIDI drum pad.
A visual artist links a controller's knobs to a live visual show.
A DJ tool in the browser reads a controller for mixing.
A site can tell which MIDI devices exist, which adds to a fingerprint.

history.change: Prompt for any MIDI access, not only sysex
Web MIDI behind add-on install prompt
